meta.project: CDP Snowflake to Oracle Data Loader
meta.description: Complete ICA context artifact for the CDP ETL pipeline. Import this file into IBM ICA Context Studio to enable MCP-based retrieval of mapping rules, transformation rules, and validation logic during Bob-assisted code generation.
meta.runtime_note: ICA/MCP is used ONLY during design and code generation. The running application has NO runtime ICA or MCP dependency.

context_nodes.title: Business Glossary
context_nodes.description: Core business terms for the CDP ETL pipeline including Customer, Energy Account, Premise, Meter, Billing Account, Monthly Usage, Watermark, ETL Job Run.

terms.definition: A utility customer identified by CUSTOMER_ID (e.g. CUST-000001). May have zero or more energy accounts.
A utility service account identified by ENERGY_ACCOUNT_ID (e.g. EA-000001). Belongs to exactly one customer. Has one active billing account, premise, and meter at a time.
The physical service address identified by PREMISE_ID (e.g. PREM-000001). One active premise per energy account at a time.
The physical electricity meter identified by METER_ID (e.g. MTR-000001). One active meter per premise at a time.
One row of electricity consumption and billing data per (ENERGY_ACCOUNT_ID, BILLING_MONTH). Primary key: USAGE_ID.
A timestamp + source ID pair stored in ETL_WATERMARK that marks the last successfully processed record for a given source dataset and job type.
One execution of an ETL job, recorded in ETL_JOB_RUN with read/insert/update/reject counts, status, and watermark values.
Composite watermark column computed by GREATEST(all contributing UPDATED_AT values) in the Snowflake export view.
A pricing plan code (e.g. RES-STD) with associated fixed, energy, demand, and tax rate parameters stored in REF.CODE_VALUE.ATTRIBUTES.

context_nodes.title: Column-Level Mappings
context_nodes.description: Machine-readable column mapping rules. Each entry has a stable CM-NNN identifier.

key_mappings.transform: Layer 1 Snowflake computed — validator checks not null, not negative

context_nodes.title: Transformation Rules
context_nodes.description: Two-layer transformation: Layer 1 executes in Snowflake views, Layer 2 in Spring Batch processors.

rules.name: FullNameNormalized
rules.description: TRIM(UPPER(FIRST_NAME) || ' ' || COALESCE(UPPER(MIDDLE_NAME) || ' ', '') || UPPER(LAST_NAME)) — computed by VW_DAILY_CUSTOMER_EXPORT

rules.name: FullAddress
rules.description: TRIM(ADDRESS_LINE1 || COALESCE(', ' || ADDRESS_LINE2, '') || ', ' || CITY || ', ' || STATE_CODE || ' ' || ZIP_CODE)

rules.name: FixedCharge
rules.description: FIXED_RATE (direct pass-through). NULL if rate plan has no fixed component.

rules.name: EnergyCharge
rules.description: ROUND(KWH_USAGE * ENERGY_RATE_PER_KWH, 2). NULL if ENERGY_RATE_PER_KWH is NULL.

rules.name: DemandCharge
rules.description: CASE WHEN PEAK_DEMAND_KW IS NOT NULL AND DEMAND_RATE_PER_KW IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(PEAK_DEMAND_KW * DEMAND_RATE_PER_KW, 2) ELSE 0 END. NULL demand_rate → 0, not NULL.

rules.name: TaxAmount
rules.description: ROUND(CALC_SUBTOTAL * TAX_RATE, 2). NULL if subtotal or tax_rate is NULL.

rules.name: TotalBilled
rules.description: CALC_SUBTOTAL + CALC_TAX_AMOUNT. NULL if either addend is NULL.

rules.name: BooleanToNumber
rules.description: TRUE→1, FALSE→0 for Oracle NUMBER(1,0) columns (IS_ACTIVE, IS_CORRECTION, AUTO_PAY_ENROLLED, PAPERLESS_ENROLLED)

rules.name: PrimaryEmailSelection
rules.description: QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_DATE DESC) = 1 WHERE CONTACT_TYPE='EMAIL' AND IS_PRIMARY=TRUE

rules.name: CurrentBillingAccount
rules.description: QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ENERGY_ACCOUNT_ID ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_DATE DESC) = 1 WHERE END_DATE IS NULL OR END_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE()

rules.name: ActiveMeter
rules.description: QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PREMISE_ID ORDER BY INSTALL_DATE DESC) = 1 WHERE IS_ACTIVE=TRUE

context_nodes.title: Validation Rules
context_nodes.description: Record-level validation rules. REJECT causes RecordValidationException → ETL_RECORD_ERROR. LOG WARN continues processing.

USG-INVK-* records intentionally violate this rule

context_nodes.title: Incremental Loading and Watermark Rules
context_nodes.description: Composite per-table watermark strategy for multi-source incremental detection.
context_nodes.advance_rule: Update ETL_WATERMARK only AFTER successful Oracle target commit. Never advance past unprocessed or rejected records unless error/replay design explicitly handles replay.
context_nodes.first_run: First run uses EPOCH_MIN = 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z — reads all records
context_nodes.idempotency: Rerun with no new data completes with zero writes and leaves watermark unchanged

context_nodes.title: Initial Load Rules
context_nodes.description: Rules governing the one-time initial full-load of all Snowflake data into Oracle.
load_sequence: Step 2: loadCustomerAccountsStep — VW_DAILY_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_EXPORT → TGT_ENERGY_ACCOUNT + TGT_BILLING_ACCOUNT + TGT_PREMISE + TGT_METER

rules.rule: Flyway V001-V004 must be applied before initial load runs
Only one initial load job at a time. Concurrent DAILY or MONTHLY jobs also blocked. Returns HTTP 409.
All steps use Oracle MERGE — safe to rerun
Watermark stored only after successful step commit. Allows restart from failure point.

context_nodes.title: Monthly Usage Load Rules
context_nodes.description: Rules for monthly electricity usage and billing load. Charge calculations performed in Snowflake Layer 1.

dataset_notes.cohorts: Two 932-row cohorts — treated as normal demo data

context_nodes.calculation_rule_summary: All 7 charge calculation steps (FIXED, ENERGY, DEMAND, SUBTOTAL, TAX, TOTAL, QUALITY_STATUS) computed in Snowflake. Spring Batch validates results but does not recalculate.

context_nodes.title: Error Handling Rules
context_nodes.description: Specification for ETL_RECORD_ERROR content and rejection behaviour.
context_nodes.skip_policy: Spring Batch skip policy catches RecordValidationException only. All other exceptions fail the job.
context_nodes.security_rule: Never store private keys, passwords, tokens, SSN, full customer PII in PAYLOAD_EXCERPT. Store record ID and error context only.
